stem: Four parameters each have ten candidate values. One pass tests all ten values for each parameter separately, holding the others fixed. How many evaluation slots are used, what is the full-grid size, and what percentage is the ratio?
assumptions: Count evaluation slots, including any repeated tuple; one pass only.
